plan: In a one-shot second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, the dominant strategy is truthful bidding. Underbidding risks losing when my value exceeds others’ bids; overbidding risks winning and paying a second-highest price above my value, yielding negative profit. With no informative history and uniform values, I should bid my true value to maximize expected payoff. Therefore, I will bid exactly 46.0.
